ai.kicker.label: Applied AI
ai.title: AI that can explain its boundaries.
ai.desc: I treat the model as one component in a controlled system — useful for interpretation and planning, never trusted with unrestricted execution.
ai.grounded.title: Grounded
ai.grounded.desc: Semantic retrieval uses a project-owned capability catalog, Voyage embeddings when configured, and lexical fallback.
ai.constrained.title: Constrained
ai.constrained.desc: Structured planning and policy checks restrict the model to known reporting capabilities and authorized data scopes.
ai.deterministic.title: Deterministic
ai.deterministic.desc: Only approved, parameterized, read-only SQL is executed. The AI never writes SQL or directly accesses the database.
ai.observable.title: Observable
ai.observable.desc: Jobs, checkpoints, events, audit data, tracing, and durable PostgreSQL state make decisions inspectable and recoverable.
ai.principle: The model plans. Policy validates. Deterministic code executes.
